Features.title: Everything you need to price CNC parts in one place
Features.subtitle: Built for Thai CNC shops — easy, accurate, and saved automatically

step.title: Auto STEP File Analysis
step.desc: Upload .step / .stp — OpenCASCADE computes volume + stock size automatically. No manual measuring required.

pdfjpg.title: AI Reads PDF/JPG Drawings
pdfjpg.desc: Upload multiple PDF/JPG/PNG drawings at once. AI extracts Material, Stock Size, Coating, Tolerance, holes, etc.

calc.title: Auto Cost Calculation
calc.desc: Material + CNC + Setup + Coating + Surface + Wire Cut calculated using your shop's formula. Precision Base 1-20 levels.

excel.title: Save to Excel Instantly
excel.desc: Every calculation auto-saves to your Excel file in beautifully formatted sheets, with daily separation and highlighted totals.

ai.title: Multi-AI Engine
ai.desc: Gemini primary + OpenRouter (Qwen, GLM, Claude, Llama) auto-fallback when quota exhausted.

chat.title: Material AI Chat
chat.desc: Ask about Density, Material Spec, Hardening, Coating, Tolerance, Welding and more — answers in 2 seconds.

Pricing.title: Pick the plan that fits you
Pricing.subtitle: Free covers the essentials forever — paid plans unlock advanced AI features (PDF/JPG batch, Multi-AI, AI Chat) and unlimited files
